blocksHtml:
• Description
  • Product Table
  • Video
  • Review

The Cambium Networks ePMP Force 300-16 is a compact and powerful wireless subscriber module built for Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP) applications. Featuring a 16 dBi integrated panel antenna, this 5GHz radio delivers up to 500 Mbps real throughput, offering a cost-effective and reliable solution for last-mile wireless broadband and surveillance backhaul.

Powered by 802.11ac Wave 2 technology, the Force 300-16 supports MU-MIMO, enhanced capacity, and reduced latency, even in high-interference environments. It’s perfect for WISPs, enterprise extensions, and rural internet distribution in Bangladesh.


Key Features:

  • Frequency: 5GHz (5150 – 5850 MHz)

  • Throughput: Up to 500 Mbps real TCP/IP

  • Integrated 16 dBi Panel Antenna

  • Supports PTMP and PTP (short range)

  • 802.11ac Wave 2 with MU-MIMO

  • Low latency and high spectral efficiency

  • Compact, weatherproof design (IP55 rated)

  • Ideal for short to mid-range wireless deployments


Link Distance:

  • Maximum PTMP Distance: Up to 5–8 km

  • PTP Short Links: Up to 10 km (with clear line-of-sight and proper alignment)
